text: Roth Ramach is an Irish mythological object. Writers call this vehicle a flying wheel, and it carried Tlachtga, called a witch or goddess, together with her wizard parent Mog Ruith. Riding it, the two moved through the air with ease. They could go as far as Italy. People say the ruins of the machine still show in a stone near Dromine in County Tipperary.

okr.objective: Record Roth Ramach as the flying wheel the witch Tlachtga and her father used to travel.
